description: Figure 2 presents a bar chart titled “NDCG@10” illustrating the results of an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset, where the vertical axis represents the NDCG@10 score ranging from 0.05 to 0.25 in increments of 0.05, and the horizontal axis lists four categorical labels: “Ours,” “critiquing,” “scoring,” and “ranking.” The “Ours” bar, colored orange, is the tallest, reaching approximately 0.21 on the vertical scale. The “critiquing” bar, colored blue, is slightly shorter at approximately 0.20. The “scoring” bar, also blue, is the shortest, reaching approximately 0.07. The “ranking” bar, blue, is approximately 0.13. The bars are arranged horizontally in the order listed on the x-axis and are not sorted by value. There is no visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or outlining applied to any of the bars. According to the figure caption, “critiquing” refers to attribute-based item critiquing, “scoring” refers to generative item scoring, and “ranking” refers to efficient candidate ranking.
